items.mainDefect: Office365 event creation selects the first host's destination calendar instead of the destination matching the current credential.

secondary.defect: Lark event creation also selects the first destination instead of the destination matching the current credential.
The base calendar service also selects the first destination instead of the destination matching the current credential.

items.mainDefect: Google Calendar updates lack a valid destination fallback when the reference has no externalCalendarId.

secondary.defect: Google Calendar deletion falls back to primary when externalCalendarId is absent, leaving events in configured secondary calendars undeleted.

items.mainDefect: Google Calendar updates search for a destination matching an absent externalCalendarId, preventing a valid destination fallback.

secondary.defect: Google Calendar deletion falls back to primary when externalCalendarId is absent instead of using the configured non-primary destination.
